author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
Sun, fun, and a wacky family tree! Take a peek behind the wires and learn all about Vision’s origin story as an Avenger - how he came to be, his relationship with Wanda, and his seemingly perfect suburban life (ft. a synthezoid dog!) in this episode of Marvel Recap: The Vision Family.

Marvel Television’s #VisionQuest, streams October 14 only on Disney+.
